This '''Dazouri''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Farmer/Legends|farmer]] from the remote [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Gibbela]]. Like the rest of [[Dazouri|his species]], the farmer was polymorphic, being able to change into a small, weak form, and a larger, dangerous form with claws. During the rule of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], a small Imperial task force was [[Mission to Gibbela|dispatched]] to Gibbela to conquer the planet for the Empire. While farming in his smaller form, the taskforce landed in a [[Sentinel-class landing craft/Legends|''Sentinel''-class landing craft]] in the middle of the farmer's crops. Several [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] and an [[Unidentified Imperial officer (Gibbela)|officer]] disembarked and confronted the farmer, ordering him to surrender. Angered, the farmer transformed into this large form and killed the surprised Imperial troops.
